download.desktop.title: Tala for Windows and Mac
download.desktop.online: Use the same Tala account and lessons on your computer. An internet connection is required.
download.desktop.unsigned: These early desktop builds are unsigned on Windows, and the Mac builds are not approved or notarized by Apple. Your computer may show a warning before opening them.
download.desktop.windowsHelp: Windows: after checking the download source, use More info → Run anyway if offered and allowed on your computer.
download.desktop.macHelp: Mac: drag Tala to Applications. If blocked, check this download and use Open Anyway for Tala in System Settings → Privacy & Security if allowed on your computer.
download.desktop.updates: Tala’s online features update with the website. To update the desktop app itself, download and install the newer version here. Your cloud lessons stay in your account.
